item.title: [Conferences / Webinars] InfoSecCon 2026 (5th Edition)
item.description:
Category: Conferences / Webinars

Date: 26 September 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-09-26

Venue: Renaissance Dhaka Gulshan Hotel, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Fee: Not Specified

Details: InfoSecCon 2026 is the 5th edition of Bangladesh's premier cybersecurity conference organized by InfoSecBulletin, bringing together researchers, academicians, journalists, cybersecurity firms, and global industry practitioners. The conference targets 300+ impactful leaders including CTOs, CISOs, CIOs, ethical hackers, red/blue team practitioners, law enforcement agencies, and policy makers to discuss cybersecurity strategies, governance, and technology roadmaps.

Sub-Events:

  • Panel Discussion: National AI Strategy: Building Secure and Trusted AI Ecosystems: A featured panel addressing security, trust, data privacy, and responsible AI governance. Moderated by Sumon Ahmed Sabir (CTO, Fiber @ Home Ltd.) with distinguished panelists including Dr. Zulkarnin Jahangir (MIT UNESCO Global AI Expert), Masud Rahman (Chief Technology Advisor, a2i), Md. Mahbubul Alam Rafee (Head of InfoSec Division, Prime Bank PLC), and Yousup Faruqu (CEO, Raptas).

item.title: [Hackathons] upay Presents AI DEV FEST 2026
item.description:
Category: Hackathons

Date: 6 - 7 October 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-09-28

Venue: Daffodil International University (DIU), Dhaka, Bangladesh

Fee: Day 1 Individual Competitions: BDT 300 per competition; Day 2 AI Hackathon: BDT 750 per team (max 3 members)

Details: Organized by DIU CPC under the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Daffodil International University, upay Presents AI DEV FEST 2026 (Snacks Partner All Time) is a nationwide inter-university AI festival. The fest brings together aspiring developers, innovators, and tech enthusiasts across four key competitive tracks—Prompt Battle, Vibe Coding, Datathon, and AI Hackathon—alongside technical seminars and hands-on workshops exploring the frontiers of AI. Features a total prize pool and awards valuation of BDT 3.35 Lakh. Every participant receives food, an ID card, a certificate, and an event kit (T-shirt, bag, pen, notebook).

Sub-Events:

  • Day 01: Individual Competitions & Technical Seminars: Individual competitive tracks including Prompt Battle, Vibe Coding, and Datathon testing creativity, coding ability, and applied AI/data reasoning (BDT 300 per contest), complemented by hands-on technical workshops.
  • Day 02: AI Hackathon: Team hackathon (maximum 3 members; BDT 750 registration fee per team) challenging participants to architect and deploy innovative AI-powered solutions to real-world problems.

item.title: [Hackathons] NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
item.description:
Category: Hackathons

Date: 14 - 15 November 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-11-14

Venue: Global / Virtual & Local In-Person Leads

Fee: Free

Details: The NASA International Space Apps Challenge is a massive global hackathon connecting students, developers, engineers, scientists, and space enthusiasts worldwide. Participants utilize NASA's open-source data to build innovative solutions addressing complex challenges across Space & Earth Science, Climate & Environment, Satellite Data, AI & Technology, and Software Development. Open to all nationalities, with options to participate individually or in collaborative teams.

Sub-Events:

  • Registration Window: Participant registration opens globally starting from August 26, 2026.
  • Core Global Hackathon Sprint: A continuous 48-hour collaborative development window taking place on November 14–15, 2026, where teams design, build, and submit projects against official NASA problem statements.

item.title: [Congress] International AI Builders Congress 2026
item.description:
Category: Congress

Date: June 30 — December 26, 2026

Registration Deadline: 2026-06-29

Venue: Daffodil International University, Ashulia Campus, Dhaka, Bangladesh

Fee: Free / Variable based on journey tracks

Details: Hosted by CloudCamp Bangladesh, the International AI Builders Congress 2026 is a premier structural execution platform designed to transition developers, innovators, and students from localized prototypes into production-grade global solutions. The comprehensive initiative focuses on key application scopes including product building, economic development, and job creation by bridging the gap between local talent and Non-Resident Bangladeshi (NRB) technology practitioners.

Sub-Events:

  • Program Schedule: Spans a multi-month structural continuum starting from onboarding sessions, routine technical check-ins, validation sprints, and interactive global mentorship labs, culminating in an expansive physical global gathering on December 26, 2026 (7:00 AM – 7:30 PM).
  • Domains & Challenges: Features structured development tasks running across 10 strategic technical domains and 50 global grand challenges. Highlighted areas focus on shipping secure, responsible, and enterprise-grade tools across healthcare, finance, legal networks, climate intelligence, agricultural modeling, civic frameworks, commerce, and fundamental AI infrastructure.
  • Judging Criteria: Solutions undergo strict evaluation across core metrics: Innovation & Originality (20%), Technical Execution & Structural Integrity (20%), Business Model & Global Sustainability Pathways (20%), alongside Measurable Real-World Impact & Ethical Compliance Protocols (20%).
  • Phases & Stages: Divided into progressive execution horizons: Phase 1 maps initial team configuration, problem identification, and technical onboarding. Phase 2 covers architecture build-outs and product development sprints under global practitioners. Phase 3 drives deployment testing, real-user validations, and international scalability readiness leading up to the final showcases.
